query:
UPDATE onetime_kyber_prekeys
            SET used = true
            WHERE id = (
                SELECT id
                FROM onetime_kyber_prekeys
                WHERE user_id = $1 AND device_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2 AND used = false
                ORDER BY id
                LIMIT 1
                FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
            )
            RETURNING key_id, public_key
